Distribution and bionomics (Fig. 39). East Palaearctic, boreal. The species is known from a large series from the type locality, Kodar Range, in North Transbaikalia; one female found in an old collection (coll. ZISP, 1913) from Verkhoyansk, Yakutia and one female was collected in Bureya Range in the north of the Amur bassin. The species occurs in subarctic habitats near timberline at 800 – 1100 m with scattered low-growing larch trees, montane meadows, and montane tundra. Larva and larval biology unknown.
